amat_definition: hit_time + miss_rate * extra_miss_penalty; writeback stalls not included
random_summary: W4 random, all seeds 1..10, arithmetic mean, sample stddev ddof=1, min and max
selection: all 96 planned runs must succeed; failed runs retained and excluded from summaries
aggregation: each deterministic scenario separately; W4-even separately from W4-random; no pooled overall AI win score
limitations: Assumed latencies, not hardware measurements; no inference test or energy claim
